from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Represents the extractable metadata from a single legal document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title or label of the document as provided (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or case category explicitly stated in the document (e.g., '行政赔偿', '刑事赔偿')")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The legal document type, e.g., '裁定书', '判决书', '决定书'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
